name: ThemeToggle
description: Lets people choose light, dark, high contrast or system. The choice sets data-theme on the document, the attribute the tokens switch on, persists in localStorage and is applied before first paint by a blocking head snippet, so there's no flash. System follows prefers-color-scheme live. Segmented is a radio group on the segmented Tabs track; icon is one button that switches light and dark; menu is a DropdownMenu of radio items.

livewire.name: theme-toggle
capabilities: wire:model binds the choice; without it the stored choice shows
@apuiThemeScript in <head> applies the stored choice before first paint
The 2.x light and dark labels still work, as lightLabel and darkLabel

react.name: ThemeToggle
capabilities: ThemeScript in <head> applies the stored choice before first paint

vue.name: ThemeToggle
capabilities: ThemeScript in <head> applies the stored choice before first paint

props.name: value
props.description: The choice. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model. Without it, the stored choice shows, else system.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The choice an uncontrolled toggle shows when nothing is stored.

props.name: variant
props.description: Segmented shows every choice on a track; icon is one button that switches between light and dark; menu opens the choices from a Theme button. Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: size
props.description: The track's, the button's or the trigger's size. Emitted as data-size.

props.name: choices
props.description: The choices segmented and menu offer, in the order light, dark, high-contrast, system. Defaults to all four.
props.a11y: Keep high contrast offered: don't hide it behind settings only.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Segmented shows only the icons. The names stay, visually hidden, as each radio's accessible name. Emitted as data-icon-only.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the radio group and the menu, and is the menu trigger's text. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __().

props.name: systemLabel
props.description: The system choice's name in the segmented control.

props.name: matchSystemLabel
props.description: The system choice's name in the menu.

props.name: switchToLightLabel
props.description: The icon button's accessible name while it switches to light.

props.name: switchToDarkLabel
props.description: The icon button's accessible name while it switches to dark.

props.name: persist
props.description: Stores the choice in localStorage, where the head snippet reads it.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: The localStorage key. Pass the same key to the head snippet.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { list: '…', option: '…', button: '…', trigger: '…', menu: '…', item: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: Holds the control. Segmented: also .apui-tabs, holding the list (a radiogroup scoped tabs) and a role=radio trigger per choice. Icon: a ghost .apui-button. Menu: an outline .apui-button trigger and the .apui-dropdown-menu of menuitemradio items, scoped dropdown-menu (D-019).

events.name: value-change
events.description: The person chose another theme, by click, the keyboard or the icon button, in this toggle. Setting value doesn't fire it.

keyboard.action: Segmented: moves to the checked choice, then out of the group.
Segmented: moves to the next or previous choice and applies it, wrapping. ArrowLeft and ArrowRight follow the text direction, so in RTL ArrowLeft moves to the next choice.
Segmented: moves to the first or last choice and applies it.
Icon: switches the theme. Menu: opens the menu, then applies the focused choice.
Menu: closes it and returns focus to the trigger.

requirements: Segmented is a role=radiogroup named by label, with a role=radio per choice, aria-checked, and only the checked one in the Tab order.
Every radio and menu item has its name, also when only icons show: iconOnly keeps it visually hidden.
The icon button's name says what it does (Switch to dark theme), and changes with the theme.
The menu's choices are menuitemradio with aria-checked, and the trigger shows the current choice's icon.
The choice persists and is applied before first paint, so there is no flash: put the head snippet in <head>.
Storage is guarded: a private window or blocked storage falls back to the default, without errors.
ArrowLeft and ArrowRight follow the text direction: in RTL, ArrowLeft moves to the next choice.
The checked choice is shown by surface and edge, not by color alone; the focus ring shows on the focused choice.
